subagents.name: Memory & Chunk Map Sub-Agent
subagents.role: Indexes all repository files into exact line-range semantic chunks for surgical chunk editing

subagents.name: Game Catalog & Thumbnail Sub-Agent
subagents.role: Scans games/*, generates missing manifests/thumbnails, and syncs games/registry.json

subagents.name: JS/HTML/Python Syntax QA Sub-Agent
subagents.role: Extracts inline <script> blocks and .js/.mjs files and compiles them with vm.Script to catch syntax errors

subagents.name: Arcade Viewport & Controls Auditor Sub-Agent
subagents.role: Audits every game in games/* for responsive canvas/viewport scaling, controls metadata, and asset links

subagents.name: Modular Game Blueprint Sub-Agent
subagents.role: Designs chunk-friendly game architecture with clearly marked section boundaries ([STATE], [INPUT], [UPDATE], [RENDER])

subagents.name: Asset & Build Package Sub-Agent
subagents.role: Verifies SVG/PNG thumbnails and downloadable build packages across games/*

subagents.name: Chunk Granularity & Size Auditor Sub-Agent
subagents.role: Monitors semantic chunk line lengths so files stay modular for surgical chunk editing

subagents.name: 3D Mesh & Topology Sub-Agent (1/4 Modeling)
subagents.role: Builds 3D primitives, lathe/spline geometry, kitbashed assemblies, and face extrusions in AI-Blender

subagents.name: Modifiers, Deform & Sculpt Sub-Agent (2/4 Modeling)
subagents.role: Applies Subdivision Surface, Mirror, Radial Array, Twist/Taper/Bend, Noise Displace, and Sculpt brushes

subagents.name: Principled BSDF & Lighting Sub-Agent (3/4 Modeling)
subagents.role: Configures metallic/roughness PBR materials, emissive neon glow, clearcoat, and 3-point studio lighting

subagents.name: Rigging, Online Fetch & OBJ/glTF Export Sub-Agent (4/4 Modeling)
subagents.role: Fetches online .gltf/.glb/.obj models or exports AI-Blender meshes to Wavefront OBJ, glTF 2.0, and JS modules

subagents.name: Deep App/Game Research & Full-Clone Sub-Agent (Coding)
subagents.role: Performs 5-layer deep research teardowns of any app or game to recreate 100% of its functions

subagents.name: AAA Visual Polish, Shaders & Synth Audio Sub-Agent (Coding)
subagents.role: Ensures all games and recreated apps have 60fps animations, glassmorphism HUDs, particles, and synth audio
